```plato
    // The product of a coordinate-list matrix with a system vector: one sweep of
    // the entries, each scattering its contribution into the row it names. The
    // cost is the entry count, independent of how the entries are ordered and of
    // how many of them repeat a position.
    Multiply(m: SparseMatrix, x: Array<Number>): Array<Number>
    {
        var accumulated = FilledNumbers(m.NumRows, 0.0);
        var k = 0;
        while (k < m.Entries.Count)
        {
            var e = m.Entries[k];
            accumulated = e.Row.AddAt(accumulated, e.Value * x[e.Column]);
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return accumulated.Freeze();
    }
```
